thread:
sam: We need an auditable export pattern for incident 677 (auth + host logs). Requirements: short triage copy (48h), sealed copy (7d), RBAC, and KMS handling. Can infra support region-aware buckets + per-export CMKs?

sec-bot: Opened ticket SEC-677-EXPORTS https://tickets/SEC-677-EXPORTS :lock:

indra: Yes. Proposed: two-step export. 1) triage: ephemeral bucket, presigned URL, assume-role expires 48h. 2) sealed: object lock + separate CMK, retention 7d, access only via approval. Redact PII before export.

kevin: KMS notes: use envelope encryption (GenerateDataKey) and store ciphertext blob in object metadata. Rotation okay as long as CMK not scheduled for deletion. For cross-account unwrap use KMS Grants and audit grant ids.

pat: RBAC: add `export_requester` (create job) and `export_reviewer` (approve sealed). Role assumption must include ticket id tag and require MFA. All assume+download events logged.

sam: Legal: EU logs must remain in eu-west-1. Automation should fail job if residency mismatches.

legal-bot: Confirmed. If PII present and crossing regions, need documented justification. Sealed copies with EU PII must remain in EU region.

indra: Implementation sketch: redact lambda -> bundle -> kms:GenerateDataKey -> upload to regional bucket -> apply lifecycle for TTL -> record audit manifest with signer and checksum. Abort if redaction regex finds unexpected PII patterns.

kevin: CLI examples and policy snippets in PR Ill open. Use presigned URLs for downloads and compare checksums post-download.

sam: Action items: indra prototype redaction + packaging, kevin KMS/helper, pat RBAC template, legal confirm retention. Target PR + runbook in 48 hours.

sec-bot: Tasks assigned in ticket. :spiral_calendar:

sam: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
